return]]></text></command><command event="Closing"><text><![CDATA[select 'dispose$Griddthuchi$(this);' as message
return]]></text></command></commands><script ><text><![CDATA[
function load$Griddthuchi$(g) {
  g.add_itemValueChanged(onChange$Griddthuchi$);
  g.add_onResponseComplete(on$Griddthuchi$ResponseComplete);
  g.add_commandEvent(on$Griddthuchi$ExecuteCommand);
  g.$a = {
    tt_qd: '[tt_qd]:=[ty_gia_hd]==0?[tien]:[tien]/[ty_gia_hd]',
    chenh_lech_nt: '[chenh_lech_nt]:=[cl_nt]-[tien_nt]',
    tt_nt: '[tt_qd]:=[tien_nt]',
    tt: '[tt_qd]:=[tien]',
    tien: '[tien]:=[tien_nt]*[$ty_gia]',
    tien_tggs: '[tien]:=[tien_nt]*[ty_gia_ht2]',
    t_tien_nt: ['t_tien_nt', 'tien_nt'],
    t_tien: ['t_tien', 'tien'],
    t_tt: '[t_tt]:=[t_tien]+[t_thue]',
    t_tt_nt: '[t_tt_nt]:=[t_tien_nt]+[t_thue_nt]'
  };
  g.$h = [['voucherCode', 'String', g._voucherCode], 'ma_kh', 'ngay_lct', 'ma_dvcs', 'stt_rec'];
  udf$Detail$(g);
}
function dispose$Griddthuchi$(g) {
  g.$a = null;
  try {g.remove_commandEvent(on$Griddthuchi$ExecuteCommand);} catch (ex) {}
  try {g.remove_itemValueChanged(onChange$Griddthuchi$);} catch (ex) {}
  try {g.remove_onResponseComplete(on$Griddthuchi$ResponseComplete);} catch (ex) {}
}

function onChange$Griddthuchi$(sender, eventArgs) {
  var o = eventArgs.get_object(), g = o.grid, f = g.get_element().parentForm, name = o.field.Name, v = f.getItemValue('loai_ct');
  switch (name) {    
    default:
      break;
  }
}
function on$Griddthuchi$ExecuteCommand(sender, e) {
  var action = e.type.Action, g = sender, f = g.get_element().parentForm, v = $func.trim(f.getItem("loai_ct").value);
  switch (action) {
    case 'AfterInsertRow':
      break;
    case 'AfterRemoveRow':
      break;
    case 'AfterCloneRow':
      g.setItemFieldValue('stt_rec0', e.type.Value, '');
      break;
    case 'Check':
      g.validRowExpression('ma_kh_tc', '(![tk_cn]) || ([ma_kh_tc] != "")');
      break;
    case 'Copying':
      set$Voucher$EmptyExternalField(g, 'stt_rec_pkt');
      break;
    case 'zcPaste':  	
			if (f._action == 'View') break;
      g._item_paste = 'ma_hd';
      g._f_paste = 'ma_hd,ma_bp,ma_vv,tk_tc,ma_kh_tc,ma_td1,ma_td2,ma_td3,ma_phi'
      g._ta_check = 'dmhd,dmbp,dmvv,dmphi,dmtk,dmkh'
      g._f_check = 'ma_hd,ma_bp,ma_vv,ma_phi,tk_tc,ma_kh_tc'
      g.showForm('zcFormPaste');		
      break;       
    default:
      break;
  }
}
function on$Griddthuchi$ResponseComplete(sender, e) {
  var g = e.object, context = e.type.Context, result = e.type.Result, o = e.type.Object, f = g.get_element().parentForm;
  console.log(context);
  switch (context) {  
    case 'Account':
      g.setItemGridBehavior(o, [['tk_cn', result[0].Value, '', false]]);
      break;
    case 'Download':
      g._key = result[0].Value;
      break;
     case 'CHECK_EXIST':
			 var row = o.row      
      for (var i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {        
        var oo = g._getItem(row + i, g._activeColumn)
        oo.row = row + i
        oo.focus() 
        g.setItemGridBehavior(oo, [[oo.field.Name, oo.value, ['', result[i][1] == 1], true]]);
      }			
			break;   
    case 'GetName':					
		  var row = o.row
      
      for (var i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {        
        var oo = g._getItem(row + i, g._activeColumn)
        oo.row = row + i
        oo.focus()
 
        g.setItemGridBehavior(oo, [[oo.field.Name, oo.value, [result[i][2], result[i][1] == 1], true]]);
      }			
			break;
    case 'tk_tc':		  
      var row = o.row
      
      for (var i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {        
        var oo = g._getItem(row + i, g._activeColumn)
        oo.row = row + i
        oo.focus()
 
        g.setItemGridBehavior(oo, [[oo.field.Name, oo.value, [result[i][2], result[i][1] == 1], true], ['tk_cn', result[i][3], '', false] ]);
      }			
			break;  
   case 'ma_hd':
      g.setItemGridBehavior(o, [['ma_vv', result[0].Value, null, false], ['ten_vv%l', result[1].Value, null, false]]);      
      break;   
    default:
      break;
  }
}


function set$Griddthuchi$Payment(o, g, f) {
  var c = g._getItemValue(o.row, g._getColumnOrder('ma_nt_i'));
  if (c == f.getItemValue('ma_nt')) g.executeExpression(o, [g.$a.tt_nt]);
    else {
      if (c == f._baseCurrency) g.executeExpression(o, [g.$a.tt]);
        else g.executeExpression(o, [g.$a.tt_qd]);
    }
}
function onChange$Griddthuchi$Account(o){
  var g = o.grid, f = g.get_element().parentForm;
  if (f.getItemValue('loai_ct') == '3') {o.grid.request(o, 'Account', 'Account', ['tk_tc'], o.grid.$h, true);}
}
function onChange$GridVoucherDetail$ma_hd(o){
 var g = o.grid, f = g.get_element().parentForm;
 o.grid.request(o, 'ma_hd', 'ma_hd', ['ma_hd'], o.grid.$h, true);
}
]]></text></script><queries ><query event="Loading"><text><![CDATA[
        select @@fieldExternal from dthuchi a left join dmtk b on a.tk_tc = b.tk left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh_tc = c.ma_kh left join dmkh e on a.ma_kh_lq = e.ma_kh  left join dmdvcs z1 on a.ma_dvcs_lq = z1.ma_dvcs 
          where a.stt_rec = @stt_rec order by a.line_nbr
    ]]></text></query></queries><response ><action id="Account"><text><![CDATA[
        if exists(select 1 from dmtk where tk = @tk_tc and loai_tk = 1) begin
          select tk_cn from dmtk where tk = @tk_tc
          return
        end  
    ]]></text></action><action id="CHECK_EXIST"><text><![CDATA[    
        declare @q nvarchar(max)
        select '' as array$, _id as id, val, 0 as _e into #val from dbo.fsd_StringToTable(@value)        
        if not(@f = '' or @ta = '')	
        begin		
	        set @q = 'update #val set _e = 1 from #val a join '  + @ta + ' b on a.val = b.' + @f 		
	        exec (@q)	
        end
        select array$, _e from #val
        return

    ]]></text></action><action id="GetName"><text><![CDATA[    
        declare @q nvarchar(max)
        select '' as array$, _id as id, val, 0 as _e, cast('' as nvarchar(128)) as ten into #val from dbo.fsd_StringToTable(@value)        
        if not(@f = '' or @ta = '')	
        begin		
	        set @q = 'update #val set _e = 1, ten = ' + @f_n + ' from #val a join '  + @ta + ' b on a.val = b.' + @f 		
	        exec (@q)	
        end
        select array$, _e, ten from #val
        return

    ]]></text></action><action id="tk_tc"><text><![CDATA[        
      declare @q nvarchar(max)
      select '' as array$, _id as id, val, 0 as _e, cast('' as nvarchar(128)) as ten, 0 as tk_cn into #val from dbo.fsd_StringToTable(@value)        
      if not(@f = '' or @ta = '')	
      begin		
	      set @q = 'update #val set _e = 1, ten = ' + @f_n + ', tk_cn = b.tk_cn from #val a join '  + @ta + ' b on a.val = b.' + @f 		
	      exec (@q)	
      end
      select array$, _e, ten, tk_cn from #val
      return

  ]]></text></action><action id="ma_hd"><text><![CDATA[    
        select a.ma_vv, case when @@language = 'V' then ten_vv else ten_vv2 end as ten_vv
        from dmhd a left join dmvv b on a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv
        where ma_hd = @ma_hd
    ]]></text></action></response><css ><text><![CDATA[

div.ImportDataOverGreen{background-position:0 -22px;}
div.Download{background-image:url(../Images/Download.png);background-repeat:no-repeat;background-position:0 0;}
div.DownloadOverGreen{background-position:0 -22px;}
div.zcPaste{background-image:url(../images/WebResource.gif);background-repeat:no-repeat;background-position:-305px 0;}
div.zcPasteOverGreen{background-position:-305px -22px;}
]]></text></css><toolbar ><button command="Export"><title v="Toolbar.Export" e="Toolbar.Export"></title></button><button command="zcPaste"><title v="Chép dữ liệu vào cột" e="Paste Data Into Column"></title></button></toolbar>
